name: spaced-repetition
title: Spaced Repetition Scheduler (SM-2)
description: A persistence-agnostic spaced-repetition scheduler for RetrievalPracticeSession and consumer-defined practice flows: a pure schedule(state, grade, now) that returns the next opaque state and due date, plus the SpacedRepetitionScheduler/ReviewState/ReviewGrade/ReviewResult vocabulary consumers program against without knowing which algorithm is behind it. Ships the default, fully implemented SM-2 arithmetic -- initial easiness factor 2.5 with a 1.3 floor, interval growth 1/6/round(I*EF) days on success, reset to 1 day on failure. Zero runtime dependencies and nothing persisted.
